name: Cindy Batstaka
source:
Cindy is a strange girl... She enjoys working out a lot, she actually got into it thanks to Val, who she has as her role model. Cindy also has some problems socializing, especially to people she doesn't know, which makes her seem as kind of a loner sometimes.
